import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Overview', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival Rate by Class
survival_by_class = data.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 0].bar(survival_by_class.index, survival_by_class.values, color=['gold', 'silver', '#CD7F32'])
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Class')
axes[0, 0].set_xticks([1, 2, 3])

# 2. Survival Rate by Sex
survival_by_sex = data.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 1].bar(survival_by_sex.index, survival_by_sex.values, color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sex')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Survival Rate by Sex')

# 3. Age Distribution
axes[0, 2].hist(data['age'].dropna(), bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Age Distribution')

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class
data_with_fare = data[data['fare'].notna()]
for pclass in [1, 2, 3]:
    class_data = data_with_fare[data_with_fare['pclass'] == pclass]['fare']
    axes[1, 0].hist(class_data, bins=20, alpha=0.5, label=f'Class {pclass}')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Fare')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
axes[1, 0].legend()
axes[1, 0].set_xlim(0, 300)

# 5. Embarkation Port Distribution
embark_counts = data['embarked'].value_counts()
axes[1, 1].pie(embark_counts.values, labels=embark_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=['lightblue', 'lightgreen', 'lightcoral'])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Embarkation Port Distribution')

# 6. Survival Count
survival_counts = data['survived'].value_counts()
axes[1, 2].bar(['Died', 'Survived'], [survival_counts[0], survival_counts[1]], 
               color=['#d62728', '#2ca02c'])
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Overall Survival Count')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
